character_neutral/1.description: Shared character-render calibration: camera-relative soft key from screen-left, warm fill, selective rim and a neutral grey backdrop, under a display transform that keeps the canonical local colours readable (VISUAL_TARGET.md: Lighting, Colour grade, Palette anchors).
character_neutral/1.backdrop_source: median of the grey backdrop in the canonical turnaround sheet (sheet30_front, 20x40 px corner)

lights.name: Key
lights.source: VISUAL_TARGET.md Key direction 25-45 deg from screen-left, elevation 35-55 deg, 5000-5800 K; T-026: 30/40 deg (inside the range) so framing hair (fringe, temple locks) shadows less of the face, strength renormalised to keep the front-facing irradiance of the calibration note; T-031b: angle 28 deg (softer shadow edges under fringes, glasses and chins, as the soft plush reference look)

lights.name: Fill
lights.source: VISUAL_TARGET.md Fill ratio 1.6-2.5:1, warm room/bounce 3500-4500 K; T-026: moved from -50/15 deg towards the camera axis so a face framed by hair, hoods or hats still receives it (the side fill was occluded by the girl's side curls); strength renormalised to the same front-facing irradiance

lights.name: Front
lights.source: T-031b: soft warm frontal fill (large source near the camera, as the turnaround sheet's studio light): lifts faces and other camera-facing surfaces that the screen-left key leaves in shade (face skin was 17-18 L* and limb skin 5-8 L* darker than the reference; blouse 7 L* darker)

character_neutral/1.azimuth_convention: camera-relative: 0 = from the camera, +90 = from screen-left, 180 = from behind the subject
character_neutral/1.units: sun strengths in W/m2 (a sun of strength s gives a diffuse radiance of albedo*s*cos/pi); ambient is the uniform world radiance seen by everything but camera rays
character_neutral/1.calibration_note: tuned on the T-015 swatch sheet (flat patches facing the camera): front-facing irradiance ~0.97 so a lit patch displays near its base colour; neutral R/B ~1.08 (VISUAL_TARGET 1.03-1.15); T-031b: + Front fill (0.6, 5000 K): front-facing irradiance ~1.15, measured with the fidelity tool on the girl (docs/evaluation/characters/T-031b)
